name: Piece Fit
summary: A slide-the-puzzle-piece human check over a drawn lake valley that changes every round
about: A human check where you slide a jigsaw piece cut from a mountain lake picture back into its gap. The piece trails the handle on a spring, tilts with your speed and lifts with a soft shadow; on release it checks the fit, then either snaps in with a glowing seam, birds and a verified time, or shakes, tells you which way to go and slides back. Every picture is drawn fresh from a seed, with a moonlit set in dark mode.
how: Drag the handle to slide the piece along, then let go when it lines up with the gap
With the keyboard, focus the handle, use the arrow keys (Shift for bigger steps) and press Enter to check
A miss tells you to go left or right and costs one of three tries; after three you get a new picture
Press the round arrow for a new picture at any time
